nodes.label: 发现—承诺边界 claim 合同
nodes.description: Q34 typed claim/proposition contract separating discovery of a candidate claim from commitment as a current conclusion.

nodes.label: 发现—承诺 承诺门禁
nodes.description: Q34 fail-closed deterministic commitment gate/CLI: blocks premature, circular, ceiling-breach, analogy-as-mechanism, stale-head, selective, unattested, self-approved commitments.

nodes.label: 发现—承诺 Q33 试点
nodes.description: Q34 pilot claim proving the boundary: 7 Q33 components Current in Main (allowed) vs global-copyright-compliance (blocked by ceiling).

nodes.label: 责任—权限—行动轨迹 合同
nodes.description: Q35 typed responsibility-authority-action-trace contract: actor/role, authority grant, action intent/decision/execution, append-only hash-linked trajectory, responsibility attribution.

nodes.label: 责任—权限 门禁
nodes.description: Q35 fail-closed responsibility gate/CLI: blocks self-grant, model-name-as-authority, expired/revoked grant, scope breach, broken delegation, separation-of-duty, stale head, ceiling breach, uncommitted action, chain tamper, silent rewrite, Q33 bypass, forced many-hands.

nodes.label: 责任—权限 Q34 试点
nodes.description: Q35 pilot: controlled repository operation on Q34 Draft PR with separated roles (initiator/authorizer/executor/verifier); proves role separation without claiming Q34 candidate is Main-accepted.

nodes.label: 观察—预测校核 合同
nodes.description: Q36-OBS typed observation-prediction calibration contract: observation spec (event time vs available time), freeze-before-reveal prediction commitment, independent outcome binding, deterministic evaluation/calibration, residual/anomaly preservation with do-not-infer-cause marker.

nodes.label: 观察—预测校核 门禁
nodes.description: Q36-OBS fail-closed observation-prediction calibration gate/CLI: blocks temporal leaks, target/window/scope mismatch, stale heads, silent prediction rewrites, selective outcome deletion, self-generated outcomes, illegal probabilities, uncommitted-Q34-claim predictions, missing Q35 authority, Q33 rights bypass, universal-capability and causal overclaims, unbound calibration, dropped failures.

nodes.label: 观察—预测校核 Q34 试点
nodes.description: Q36-OBS pilot: freeze-before-reveal interval prediction about Q34 propagation-closure drift, bound to an independent deterministic outcome observation with calibration record; plus an honestly-marked retrospective replay fixture (RETROSPECTIVE_REPLAY_NOT_LIVE_FORECAST).

nodes.label: 干预—失效动力学 合同
nodes.description: Q36-INT typed intervention-failure dynamics contract: intervention request (Q34-committed claim + Q35 authority + Q36-OBS read-only observation/residual), safety envelope, controlled execution record, outcome/effect evaluation with baseline/comparator, failure mode record, and stop/rollback history; fail-closed against uncommitted claims, missing authority, residual-as-cause, external action, envelope exceed, stop-condition violation, failure rewrite, expected-effect rewrite, causal/universal overclaim, incomplete rollback, many-hands forgery, unvalidated observation, separation-of-duty violation, missing baseline.

nodes.label: 干预—失效动力学 门禁
nodes.description: Q36-INT fail-closed intervention-failure dynamics gate/CLI: blocks Q34 uncommitted claims, Q35 authority gaps, Q33 rights bypass, missing safety envelope/stop/rollback, real-world external action, envelope exceed, stop-condition violation, failure rewrite, expected-effect rewrite, causal/universal overclaim, incomplete rollback, many-hands forgery, unvalidated observation, separation-of-duty violation, missing baseline, placeholder digests and unbound Git bytes. Deterministic exit codes 0-23.

nodes.label: 干预—失效动力学 受控试点
nodes.description: Q36-INT controlled pilot: deterministic repo-local replay of an intervention bundle with Q34 claim + Q35 grant + Q36-OBS observation, asserting the fail-closed gate passes (exit 0) and stop/rollback are append-only and verified; plus 23 attack/positive fixtures. No Main mutation, no external real-world system access or control.

nodes.label: 类比审计与可运输性 合同
nodes.description: Q37-I1 typed analogy-audit & transportability contract: analogy candidates (SURFACE_SIMILARITY / METAPHOR_ONLY / STRUCTURAL_ANALOGY / MECHANISM_CANDIDATE / TRANSPORTABILITY_CANDIDATE / COUNTERANALOGY), explicit mappings (entities, correspondence, cardinality, directionality, invariants, mismatches, omitted variables, hidden premises, scale/time/context differences, digest), mechanism evidence (distinct from shared form), transportability assessments (overlap, invariances, shifts, boundary, falsifier, uncertainty), and audit decisions with claim ceiling; fail-closed against metaphor/local-isomorphism/selective-correspondence/unaudited-structural-map/Q36-residual upgraded to mechanism identity, undeclared shift, residual-as-cause, mechanism upgrade, transportability without overlap/invariance/boundary/falsifier, suppressed counteranalogy, Q14 uncommitted claim, Q35 authority gap, Q33 rights bypass, Q38 premature start, claim-ceiling overreach. Does NOT prove shared mechanism, real-world transportability or universal law; does NOT add L7/truth layer; does NOT materialize F15/D1/D2.

nodes.label: 类比审计与可运输性 门禁
nodes.description: Q37-I1 fail-closed analogy-audit & transportability gate/CLI: blocks metaphor/local-isomorphism/selective-correspondence/unaudited-structural-map/Q36-residual upgraded to mechanism identity or universal law, undeclared scale/time/context or transportability shift, mechanism evidence insufficient/circular, residual-as-cause, transportability missing overlap/invariance/boundary/falsifier, suppressed counteranalogy/negative evidence, Q34 candidate self-promotion, Q35 fictional authority, Q33 rights bypass, Q38 premature start, claim-ceiling overreach, semantic inconsistency, unbound source bytes, semantic digest mismatch and wrong actual checkout head. Deterministic exit codes 0-24.

nodes.label: 类比审计与可运输性 受控试点
nodes.description: Q37-I1 real-repo pilot: deterministic repo-local replay of an analogy bundle against the real Q34 committed claim (fix.analogy_as_mechanism from data/discovery/fixtures/05-analogy-as-mechanism.json), asserting the fail-closed gate passes (exit 0) and that Q38 case retrieval remains gated (q38_search_permission NOT_ALLOWED / ALLOWED_AS_RESTRICTED_SEED only). Plus 30 attack/positive fixtures. No Main mutation, no Q38 case retrieval, no external real-world system access or control.

nodes.label: 案例、反例与边界证据检索 合同
nodes.description: Q38-I1 typed evidence-retrieval contract: accepts only a Q37 audited restricted seed; freezes question, scope, balanced query plan, inclusion/exclusion policy and stop condition; preserves support, counterexample, boundary, negative and failed-retrieval items with source-family identity, rights, provenance, digest, access time, grade, freshness, representativeness, selection history, unresolved gaps, claim ceiling and Q39 exports. Case count cannot establish mechanism or causal proof.

nodes.label: 案例、反例与边界证据检索 门禁
nodes.description: Q38-I1 fail-closed evidence-retrieval gate with stable exits 0 and 2-21. It blocks unaudited Q37 seeds, support-only search, negative deletion, duplicate-family counting, rights bypass, stale evidence, missing representativeness, quantity voting, similarity-to-mechanism promotion, stop-condition rewrite, selective exclusion, ceiling inflation, invalid provenance/digest, incomplete selection logs, missing Q39 exports, counterevidence override, temporal invalidity, unbounded search, dangling references, nonexistent repository sources, wrong Git objects, path escape, null/placeholder bindings and digests not computed from actual retrieved bytes.

nodes.label: 案例、反例与边界证据检索 受控试点
nodes.description: Q38-I1 bounded real-repository replay: one traceable support item, counterexample, boundary case, negative result and deliberately unperformed external retrieval, all bound to the Q37 repair seed and actual repository bytes; 30 fixtures drive the real CLI. Negative and failed records export to Q39; external validity remains an explicit gap. No external fact, mechanism proof or real-world action is claimed.

nodes.label: 失败记忆与修复传播 合同
nodes.description: Q39-I1 typed append-only failure lineage across Q36 residual/rollback, Q37 mismatch/retraction and Q38 counterexample/negative/failed retrieval exports; binds origin task, artifact, exact head, digest, causal status, retry boundary, propagation and ceiling impact without proving cause.

nodes.label: 失败记忆与修复传播 门禁
nodes.description: Q39-I1 deterministic fail-closed gate: rejects broken hash chains, silent overwrite/deletion, cause overclaim, unchanged retry, missing repair propagation, no downstream plan effect, retracted claims driving actions, environment-as-theory relabeling, lost negative results, broken source binding, invalid recurrence/closure, ceiling inflation, nonexistent propagation targets, wrong Git objects or actual-byte digests, fictional authority, unbound effects and boolean-only application claims. High-risk intervention effects remain request-only.

nodes.label: 失败记忆与修复传播 受控试点
nodes.description: Q39-I1 bounded repository pilot replays Q36 rollback, Q37 analogy mismatch and Q38 counterexample/negative/failed retrieval into an append-only chain with structured Git-bound downstream plan-effect records; 30 fixtures drive the real CLI. High-risk intervention remains request-only. No real-world retry or external action.

nodes.label: Symbolic Object, Power & Multi-Perspective Governance 合同
nodes.description: SYMBOLIC-SPHERE-I1 repair-r1 contract with explicit repository reference records binding path, commit, blob, actual-byte SHA-256, record type, declared role and selected typed evidence object. Structured actor, meaning, power, face, distribution, counter-reading and material-evidence semantics replace caller-supplied pass booleans.

nodes.label: Symbolic Object, Power & Multi-Perspective Governance 门禁
nodes.description: SYMBOLIC-SPHERE-I1 repair-r1 fail-closed CLI resolves local Git commits and tree entries, recomputes blob and SHA-256 integrity, checks actual object roles, and independently validates material objects, actors, meaning projections, allowed power modalities, distinct faces, benefit/cost distribution, counter-reading evidence, material downgrade, truth ceiling and causal ceiling with stable exits 0 and 2-20.

nodes.label: Symbolic Object, Power & Multi-Perspective Governance 受控试点
nodes.description: SYMBOLIC-SPHERE-I1 repository-local synthetic pilot covering COMMUNITY_FOOTBALL_FIELD and SCHOOL_DATA_POLICY. Twenty repair fixtures use ordinary data-integrity names and exercise real Git reference resolution plus task semantics; original manifest fixture paths remain compatibility artifacts. No external action or truth/causal upgrade.

nodes.label: Principle Lock, Process Quality & Outcome-Bias Governance 合同
nodes.description: DECISION-INTEGRITY-I1 typed evidence-bound contract. Principles, assumptions, decision order, risks and stop conditions can be frozen ex ante so process quality and outcome quality remain separately auditable after results appear.

nodes.label: Principle Lock, Process Quality & Outcome-Bias Governance 门禁
nodes.description: DECISION-INTEGRITY-I1 fail-closed real CLI enforcing evidence binding, exact parent, 12 task rules, candidate ceiling and no external action.

nodes.label: Principle Lock, Process Quality & Outcome-Bias Governance 受控试点
nodes.description: DECISION-INTEGRITY-I1 self-authored bounded repository pilot covering BAD_PROCESS_GOOD_OUTCOME and GOOD_PROCESS_BAD_OUTCOME; 24 fixtures drive the real CLI; no external action.

nodes.label: Scientific Metacognition & Epistemic-State Control Plane 合同
nodes.description: SCIENTIFIC-METACOGNITION-I1 typed evidence-bound contract. Epistemic states and unknowns can be ranked and transitioned through authorized evidence acquisition with deterministic replay, bounded cost/risk/time and explicit replanning.

nodes.label: Scientific Metacognition & Epistemic-State Control Plane 门禁
nodes.description: SCIENTIFIC-METACOGNITION-I1 fail-closed real CLI enforcing evidence binding, exact parent, 12 task rules, candidate ceiling and no external action.

nodes.label: Scientific Metacognition & Epistemic-State Control Plane 受控试点
nodes.description: SCIENTIFIC-METACOGNITION-I1 self-authored bounded repository pilot covering REAL_TRAIN_UNKNOWN_LEDGER and NON_IDENTIFIABLE_UNKNOWN; 24 fixtures drive the real CLI; no external action.

nodes.label: World-Feedback Anomaly Trigger & Governance 合同
nodes.description: Q41-I1 typed evidence-bound contract. Recurring evidence-bound expected/observed divergence can trigger a bounded continue/repair/downgrade/rebuild/search decision without automatically inventing a hidden system.

nodes.label: World-Feedback Anomaly Trigger & Governance 门禁
nodes.description: Q41-I1 fail-closed real CLI enforcing evidence binding, exact parent, 10 task rules, candidate ceiling and no external action.

nodes.label: World-Feedback Anomaly Trigger & Governance 受控试点
nodes.description: Q41-I1 self-authored bounded repository pilot covering RECURRING_REPOSITORY_DIVERGENCE and SINGLE_DEVIATION_NEGATIVE_CONTROL; 24 fixtures drive the real CLI; no external action.

nodes.label: Latent-System Discovery & Identifiability Gate 合同
nodes.description: F15-D1-I1 typed evidence-bound contract. Latent-system candidates and equivalent decompositions can remain candidate objects until distinguishing evidence passes an explicit identifiability gate.

nodes.label: Latent-System Discovery & Identifiability Gate 门禁
nodes.description: F15-D1-I1 fail-closed real CLI enforcing evidence binding, exact parent, 8 task rules, candidate ceiling and no external action.

nodes.label: Latent-System Discovery & Identifiability Gate 受控试点
nodes.description: F15-D1-I1 self-authored bounded repository pilot covering IDENTIFIABLE_CANDIDATE and NON_IDENTIFIABLE_EQUIVALENCE_SET; 24 fixtures drive the real CLI; no external action.

nodes.label: Evidence-Constrained Multi-History / Multi-World Projection 合同
nodes.description: D2-I1 typed evidence-bound contract. Multiple evidence-constrained history/world candidates can preserve shared evidence, branch assumptions, indistinguishable sets and falsifiers without forcing a unique story or unjustified probability.

nodes.label: Evidence-Constrained Multi-History / Multi-World Projection 门禁
nodes.description: D2-I1 fail-closed real CLI enforcing evidence binding, exact parent, 8 task rules, candidate ceiling and no external action.

nodes.label: Evidence-Constrained Multi-History / Multi-World Projection 受控试点
nodes.description: D2-I1 self-authored bounded repository pilot covering TWO_WORLD_EQUIVALENCE_SET and WEIGHTED_WORLD_WITH_JUSTIFICATION; 24 fixtures drive the real CLI; no external action.

nodes.label: Counterfactual & Unrealized-Path Ledger 合同
nodes.description: Q42-I1 typed evidence-bound contract. Counterfactuals, alternative decompositions, unrealized paths and speculative narratives can be kept distinct, and only identifiable portions receive bounded counterfactual status.

nodes.label: Counterfactual & Unrealized-Path Ledger 门禁
nodes.description: Q42-I1 fail-closed real CLI enforcing evidence binding, exact parent, 8 task rules, candidate ceiling and no external action.

nodes.label: Counterfactual & Unrealized-Path Ledger 受控试点
nodes.description: Q42-I1 self-authored bounded repository pilot covering IDENTIFIABLE_COUNTERFACTUAL and SPECULATIVE_UNREALIZED_PATH; 24 fixtures drive the real CLI; no external action.

nodes.label: Graded Intervention & Professional Escalation 合同
nodes.description: Q43-I1 typed evidence-bound contract. Actions can be classified by risk, reversibility, evidence, authority and expertise so only repository-local reversible actions are automatic and high-risk external actions become request-only escalations.

nodes.label: Graded Intervention & Professional Escalation 门禁
nodes.description: Q43-I1 fail-closed real CLI enforcing evidence binding, exact parent, 10 task rules, candidate ceiling and no external action.

nodes.label: Graded Intervention & Professional Escalation 受控试点
nodes.description: Q43-I1 self-authored bounded repository pilot covering REPOSITORY_LOCAL_REVERSIBLE and HIGH_RISK_REQUEST_ONLY; 24 fixtures drive the real CLI; no external action.
